reconcile.note: Gill explains the seeming clash by naming the intervening generation: Jehu is son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi, so 'son of Nimshi' names his ancestor.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses the plain wording that one verse calls Jehu Nimshi's son and another calls him his grandson within the same narrative.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Jehu the son of Nimshi shall you anoint to be king over Israel
sides.verseText: and Jehu the son of Nimshi shall you anoint to be king over Israel; and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah shall you anoint to be prophet in your room.

sides.snippet: Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi
sides.verseText: When you come there, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brothers, and carry him to an inner chamber.
